sources_read.section: the 026/033 seam — ids and the mirrored page
bbox.color is string|null, resolved at render
the surfaces that never got the 039 pass
where a page change is dispatched
the .textLayer rules the app never imported

scope: Four small reader controls (tour restart, rail folds, keyboard paging, four highlight colours), the surfaces 039 left un-polished, and the document-layout/text-layer defect the live pass turned up. Out of scope: persisting rail visibility or the colour choice, per-row colour editing, spread/continuous layout modes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A header control reopens the tour at 1 / 8; finishing or skipping still records it.
A chevron beside each rail's title folds it; a thin handle with its name brings it back; the page takes the width.
A mark made while the notes rail is folded produces a toast naming where it went, whose action reopens the rail.
Four swatches; a new mark stores the key; the canvas paints the hue; rows without a key read as the default.
Arrows page when the reader is free to page; a field, a tablist, a slider or an open dialog wins.
The note sheet, editor, writing check, persona editor, export and re-import read as one system.
Pages stack on a sized box; the text layer is positioned; a captured highlight lands on the text it selected.

open_questions: Whether rail visibility should persist per account (today it resets on reload) — a product call, like 042's ordering question.
Whether a highlight's colour should be editable after the fact (needs a repository update path).
risks: The pdf.js text-layer fix changes captured rects for the better, but any stored row made before it keeps rects computed against the broken layer.
Folding a rail unmounts the note panel, so its local selection is dropped — acceptable, the rail is a view.
The keyboard listener is global: the dialog/text-field/tablist guards are what keep it from stealing keys.
